UNASKED: The cycle-inside/after-cycle validation block in runner.sh refuses `--from-stage` when the target is a stage inside a cycle or after a cycle, emitting `pipeline.from_stage.rejected` | WHY: No requirement in RQRESU-1 through RQGUAR-2 defines this restriction, and no test in the issue's named test files asserts it or would go red if it were removed | QUOTE: core/pipeline/runner.sh | error "--from-stage '$from_stage' lands inside or after a cycle ('${_fs_cycle_id:-after-cycle}') — refused. Resume the cycle from its first stage or omit --from-stage."

ANSWER lens-correctness-code finding 2 (opened by review_lenses): wrong — RQLOOP-1 and DSCMBR-1 are both scoped to a run "interrupted mid-round": at least one cycle member was not yet complete when the run stopped. Setting `stage_statuses.test = "aborted"` matches that exact scenario. The untested path the finding names — where ALL members are "complete" in the interrupted iteration before the restart — is not a mid-round interruption and no ISSUE REQUIREMENT covers it. The test correctly covers what DSCMBR-1 requires; the edge case is outside this issue's scope.
